notes.title: Changelog for Versions 0.75.6 - 0.75.7.5 Alpha
notes.notes:
Hello all, it's been a while since the last patch notes. While updates were released, they were a bit sneakier this time. We've taken the time to compile a list of changes that happened during this absence of patch notes, as well as the current version.

So here's a changelog of the newest update and previous updates that were not announced

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36134202/be3fd938f23ac4c04feb83d4bf71701b1754646a.png

Current Version 0.75.7.5 Alpha

 Added a tooltip in Forge that would display if a card for crafting is currently in a deck
 Improved Chat response rate
 Disabled the Guild Button in Chat
 Made visibility improvements in Forge text
 Made UI improvements in Forge new card crafted
 Fixed a few text errors in two items
 Fixed a bug in Forge that would show the wrong amount of cards available for to use for crafting
 Fixed a bug in Forge where the recipe amount number always showed 1
 Fixed a bug in Forge that would not immediately show newly crafted cards in deckbuilding


Previous Version 0.75.7.3-4 Alpha

 Fixed a bug with the Wins in a Row achievements constantly resetting and giving no rewards
 Fixed a bug in Commander Quests where teleporting in a quest sometimes caused the wrong image to appear
 Fixed a bug in Commander Quests that would sometimes show wrong rewards to appear after a quest resolution
 Fixed a bug in Commander Quests that would cause the game to freeze when there are duplicate quests ready


Previous Version 0.75.7.1-2 Alpha

 Clicking in a player's portrait in Chat opens a friend request submenu
 UI improvements in the arena Chat menu
 UI improvements in Forge
 UI improvements in Forge card text
 UI improvements in Fortune Teller
 Added an animation in Locksmith when Gold and Diamonds increase and decrease
 Fixed a bug in Locksmith where the lock boxes and lockpick cost was not shown on the first chest
 Fixed a bug where having the PVP Queue open prevented players from using class/portrait skills in PVG
 Fixed a bug where new cards will not immediately appear in deckbuilding to add on a deck
 Fixed a bug where some players would not get cards from the Commander Trials card pack rewards
 Fixed a bug where opening the Swamp Shark fight in Treasure Hunter would cause the main hub menu to pop up


Previous Version 0.75.7 Alpha

 Generals no longer reset from being primary whenever the game is reset, and can be unset from primary
 Lockpick Diamond cost is now shown in Locksmith when lockpicks are not enough
 Set a character limit for the Username/Nickname input fields
 UI improvements in General Quests
 UI improvements in Recipe Merchant menu
 Tottoa Noble card now shows the right layout (Neutral Layout)
 Fixed a bug in the Chat menu where the text will overflow from its frame
 Fixed a bug where diamonds could not be spent after a general quest was resolved
 Fixed a bug in Locksmith where buying lockpicks didn't immediately update the number count
 Fixed a few text errors in the choose a faction text and login rewards text


Previous Version 0.75.6 Alpha

 Avado High Cleric card now does Ranged damage (0 -> 40)
 Avado Cleric card now does Ranged damage (0-> 30)
 Added a new icon for the Divine and Shadow Runes and the Range Weapon items
 General Quests now have a reset quests button, this gives new quests to take on and resets the current pool (but not the quests already in progress)
 In the Combat Report, successfully defending against an enemy now rewards the player and the general when visited. Unclaimed rewards from successful repels are indicated with a "!" from main hub
 Card Pack card rarity chances may now be viewed by clicking the (?) button next to the pack
 UI improvements in the main hub
 UI improvements in Buy Card Packs
 UI improvements on General Quests
 UI improvements in Chat and overhaul (now with different chat rooms, and the ability to share decks)
 Moved the Chat button from the Messages menu out in the main hub
 Updated the Options button UI and moved it to the lower left corner
 Updated the Options button UI in the arena and added the Chat button (chat now also accessible in battle)
 Various visual particle fixes
 Swamp Shark card now shows the right layout (Neutral Layout)
 Changed the name of Novice Mage card to Novice Cleric
 Fixed a bug where the Enchanted Arrows card didn't work properly on Frontline cards
 Fixed a bug where the Love Story Bard ability didn't work properly
 Fixed a bug that caused Merman Warrior card to cause 0 damage when attacking first
 Fixed a bug that caused lockpicks to show the wrong amount earned
 Fixed a bug where Snow Wolves' On Deploy ability will last for more turns
 Fixed a bug where some summon cards will summon themselves as well
 Fixed a bug where sometimes the enemy could lay traps on their own field
 Fixed a bug with the Queen Catherine Card Recipe
 Fixed a bug with the Lady Dianna Swanheart where Trap Evasion would not work
 Fixed a bug with Ritual of Healing acquisition and 0 Resource Cost
 Fixed a bug with the choose a deck menu in the tutorial
 Fixed an error with the Totem cards description text
 Fixed an error in Tournament rewards text


There have been a number of exciting new things that are being worked on that we think the community will enjoy. Let's name a few.


 Extended Class Trees
 Battlegrounds
 Clans/Guilds
 Commander Quests visual update & giving items to Generals on quests
 Next Commander Trial
 New Cards


Thank you for reading, stay tuned for more.

notes.title: Version 0.75.5 Alpha
notes.notes:
A new update has been pushed for Shades Of Heroes

New

 The Water Temple Adventure can now be obtained from the Commander Trials

 10 New Steps in Commander Trials

 Division Progression is now visible in the PvG Mode
 The Party Adventure fights mode can now be accessed for testing via Options. You can find more details on how to access it from our discord server: https://discord.gg/wAZdQby


Bugfixing

 Anti Cheat false positive detection fixed
 Stability Fixed in All Arena, the game should not close unexpectedly in any arena mode anymore. If the game shuts down again unexpectedly within the Arena please report it as a bug to reopen the bug case
 Cards cannot attack the enemy player health twice anymore
 Queue Lantern doesn't prevent the cast of abilities in any resolution anymore
 Fishing Island is now working as intended and as such does not grant exponential resources every round
 Commander Trials step Worthy Adventurer now proceeds normally
 Microtransactions purchased items should now appear after the transaction is complete
 Various Particle Fixes
 We Need Speed to Enter and Hide Behind the Living Rock challenges now correctly progress when deploying cards instead of destroying them
 Pressing the Attack button in PvG no longer gets players stuck until restarting the game

Known Issues

 PvG Delayed Reload
 Pillars of Destiny Delayed Reload
 Double Summoning
 Co Op Abilities

notes.title: Version 0.75.4 Alpha
notes.notes:
A new update has been pushed for Shades Of Heroes

Bugfixing

 Fixed a huge issue preventing recipes and items in inventory from showing
 Fixed a bug preventing general recipes in inventory from showing the proper icons and text
 Fixed a bug where players would sometimes be able to buy items, cards and recipes in Valkyrie Mountain even when they didn't have enough diamonds/gold, this caused a further issue where spending diamonds afterwards was impossible
 Fixed a bug where Avado High Cleric's mass heal ability was not for all ally units and didn't count herself as an Empire unit (for the double healing)
 Fixed a turn duration issue on all Totem cards and made minor text corrections
 Fixed a bug preventing the Diamond Merchant and Become Royal panels from being opened
 Fixed a bug causing the Treasure Hunter achievement to be unlocked from the start
 If for whatever reason diamonds are in the negative it is now visible


Quality

 Slight UI update on some Main Hub panels
 Can now view currency when a trader pops up in Valkyrie Mountain
 Player Health in Valkyrie Mountain now only goes up to a maximum of 1200
 The provisions counter in Valkyrie Mountain is now more visible
 Using diamonds to teleport on pending Commander Quests now instantly resolves them (you will not have to click again to see the fight)

notes.title: Version 0.75.3 Alpha - A New Challenge
notes.notes:
A new update has been pushed for Shades Of Heroes

New

 14 New Commander Trials Missions (this is only a fraction of the new missions, 13 more will be available in the coming week, alongside a new trial adventure in the docks)
 Steam Achievements are now active and can be unlocked (upon login, players should automatically unlock the achievements they should've earned)

 4 new achievements have been added for Treasure Hunter
 Changed the values for the wins in a row achievements
 Choosing your faction now shares the same achievement

 New achievement for winning your first fight in PvG in place of choosing the Good side achievement


 Bug fixing & Quality

 Fixed a huge issue that caused players to lose almost all their gold when reaching 10 wins in a row in PvG
 Fixed Daily Rewards Loading issue.The daily rewards should now appear normally, even if the player use the menu before Daily rewards load.
 Fixed a bug where cards with [On Deploy] abilities (such as Charge or Tide Turner) would prevent players from using those cards' abilities that same turn (but AI still could)
 Fixed a bug that displayed a connection error whenever attempting to delete your account
 Fixed a bug preventing the Death From Above and Gift For a Friend achievements from progressing
 Fixed a bug preventing Tottoa Hero's abilities Heroic Spirit and Posthumous Fame from working correctly
 Fixed a bug causing the Pickaxe card to not update the resource gain value and changed its function to only work on Resource cards now
 Changed text in Tottoa Hero's description (Howling renamed to Bad Howling, now correctly displays -20 HP instead of -40 HP and Cacophony's turns duration now display the correct amount)
 UI improvements in the tutorial fights, text is now more legible on most resolutions
 UI improvements in Treasure Hunter and Commander Trials

A new update has been pushed for Shades Of Heroes.


 Deploy Positions with traps set by the player are now visible

notes.title: Version Alpha 0.74.0 - Commander Trials
notes.notes:
A new update has been pushed for Shades Of Heroes.


 Commander Trials has been added. This mode introduces challenges that a player must complete in order to finish their trials. Two islands have been added, each with their own storyline adventures as part of the trials. Commander Trials can be accessed from the top right corner of the main hub.
 Improved New Player Experience. There are now level locks on certain features and gamemodes as well as an extended dialogue tour to each feature. This is in response to the overwhelming sense that a new player could have when just starting.
 Balanced the XP and Gold gain across all gamemodes. Most gamemodes now give similar amount of rewards.
 Added new Daily Quests.
 Updated recipes and lessened the required amount to craft.
 Moved the view all cards button in deckbuilding.
 Removed the almanac button from the main hub.
 Fortune Teller now displays the amount of Challenger Marks.
 Improved Audio.
 General UI fixes.
 Fixed text errors on Co-Op abilities and Generals menu.
 Fixed a bug where the wrong card back was shown on card packs.
 Fixed a bug where the player's nickname, class and portrait was not correctly displayed on some places.
 Fixed a bug where Dire Rat's Pesting ability did not hurt Resource cards.
 Fixed a bug where Sabotage did not hurt Resource cards.
 Fixed a bug where destroying Minions with Acolyte's Blood Sacrifice ability gave its On Death ability increased power.
 Fixed a bug where abilities dealing damage to the enemy's player health dealt no damage.

notes.title: Version 0.73.0 Alpha - Island Raiding
notes.notes:
A new update has been pushed for Shades Of Heroes.

Feeling adventurous? Seek dangerous and prosperous lands and test your might in a series of difficult fights and see if your deck holds against mythical opponents! Be wary, for this venture is not for beginners.


 Island Raiding is now featured, it can be accessed through Tavern > Treasure Hunter.

 A new currency has been introduced, Explorer Points, which can be earned upon winning Island Raid battles, and can be used to explore new areas.
 Challengers have limited attempts to fight each day
 3 islands to raiding
 7 raid boss fights & rewards
 
 Players can now quickly send a friend request from the public chat by clicking on their name
 Groundworks for Clan mechanics
 Updated UI in the Fortune Teller Defeat Panel
 Updated the background map in the tutorial area
 Updated the Provisions icon
 Fixed a bug where the defeat panel in Fortune Teller would sometimes not lock the player
 Fixed a bug causing the wrong amount of rewards to show up when winning a Fortune Teller fight

notes.title: Version 0.72.0 Alpha - Smoother Progression
notes.notes:
Hello all, we'll be pushing a new update on Shades Of Heroes that aims to decrease the grind in gaining new cards as well as player XP, alongside the pesky bug fixes.


 Fixed an issue that caused the last card in a deck to not appear in your hand
 Fixed an issue that showed the wrong picklock amount when receiving new picklocks from a chest
 Fixed an issue where portrait zoom descriptions in the character menu did not show the portrait image
 Fixed an issue where equipping a portrait showed the wrong image in the character menu
 Fixed an issue where music volume reset after opening the options menu and did not save
 Fixed an issue that caused class skills in the Class Wheel menu to not appear
 Fixed an issue where the level up button always appeared
 Added a new Report Bug option in the Options menu
 Decreased Common Card Pack cost from 300 Gold and 30 Diamonds to 150 Gold and 15 Diamonds
 Decreased Uncommon Card Pack cost from 1000 Gold and 100 Diamonds to 500 Gold and 50 Diamonds
 Decreased Rare Card Pack cost from 3000 Gold and 300 Diamonds to 2000 Gold and 200 Diamonds
 Decreased Epic Card Pack cost from 10000 Gold and 1000 Diamonds to 5000 Gold and 500 Diamonds
 Levelling up now grants Gold and Diamond rewards
 Reduced XP required in order to level up, primarily on the first few levels
 Reduced the difficulty on low level Commander Quests
 Various Sound Improvements


Furthermore, we would like to thank everyone that's tried the game for the feedback they've given us these past few days, it has been very important. Lastly, as a reminder, we would like to encourage the use of our discussion page or this form for any bugs sightings or other issues, technical or otherwise. Once again, thanks a lot everyone.
